notebook_hashes.note: Two hashes are recorded on purpose. Gate A identifies the notebook by the sha256 of its INPUT (pre-execution) source, which is the artifact whose behaviour is being certified and which cannot be produced by re-running. The delivered file is the executed OUTPUT, so its sha256 differs; SHA256SUMS.txt covers the delivered file, and the source is byte-identical between input and output (only outputs/execution counts differ).
